label: late original-phase input of p/o/j/f (c/z/a)
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at late positions (orig_idx >= 4, rate rising to ~15% at orig_idx 8; 96% of mass) plus weakly on the <DEL> step; never at t<3 and never in the copy phase. Strongest on inputs p, o, j, f (~4x lift), then c, z, a. Longer sequences (L=8-9) carry most mass, and it prefers first occurrences of the token (in_first: 86% of mass). Sequences whose earlier tokens include d/y/h/v/w/m (esp. as first token) have higher rates, but adding that history condition does not improve F1 much. Predicate catches ~72% of mass but precision is only ~0.2: the same late p/o/j/f/c/z/a inputs are usually inactive, so a history-dependent factor not captured here gates it.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=4: p, o, f, j; t=6: p, o, j, f; t=8: o, j, f, p) and the first original token (most: d, y, h, w, v, m; least: f, z, o, p); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, t=7, L=9 & t=8.
